post.description: Answers the enterprise sign-in connection of the organization that verified the email address's domain, or of the organization named by its slug. Send one of `email` or `organization`. 404 when there is none, or it is off, incomplete, or its organization is suspended. Limited to 30 requests a minute per client. Send the API key in the `apikey` header.

email.description: A work email address, such as `ada@acme.com`.

connection.description: The connection's name: start the sign-in at `/auth/v1/authorize/{env}/{connection}`.

required.description: When true, people at this address cannot sign in any other way.

url.description: Where to send the browser. Add `redirect_to`.
